config_flow_discovery_remarks: This device controls a non-smart device, hence it only tracks standby power by default. You need to configure the power draw of the controlled device yourself while or after the configuring process.
description: Homematic IP trailing-edge dimming actuator for brand switch systems. This profile only models the dimmer's self-consumption; configure the connected load separately.
measure_description: Measured using Powercalc average mode for 300 seconds with a 7.61W dummy load.
name: Dimming Actuator for Brand Switches
